rationale_summary: The document overwhelmingly frames AI governance through the lens of economic competitiveness and national strategic advantage. The core motivation is to seize a first-mover advantage in AI, build internationally competitive industries, and drive economic growth. National security is a strong secondary frame, with explicit references to maintaining strategic initiative in international AI competition and supporting national defense. Social stability, labor transition, and innovation enablement also appear as secondary concerns.
